the SERF adder is a good candidate for ultra low power and fast digital multipliers at deep submicron sizes.
, the SERF-10 T Hybrid Wallace tree based multipliers are the best suited design for ultra low power and high speed computation at deep sub-micro sizes.
, the 10T adder sub-modules are more efficient in power and delay at 70nm technology node, but not at the 180nm technology node.

the proposed SERF-28T hybrid adder based multipliers are suitable for high performance and ultra low power design.
